title: the Glass Steppe Rising Revisited
author: B. M. Galloway
blurb: Paloma Reyes, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
